info.title: Contoso ERP (Lab)
info.description: Read-only access to Contoso's purchasing system for accounts-payable automation. Use this connector to look up a supplier's approval status, retrieve a purchase order with its line items and goods receipts, and post an approved invoice for payment. This is a training mock of a real ERP.

api_key.name: x-api-key
api_key.description: Static API key issued by the AP Platform team.

get.description: Returns the supplier master record, including the approval status that determines whether Contoso is permitted to pay this supplier. Call this before matching an invoice. A supplier whose status is not 'Approved' must never be auto-paid.

parameters.name: supplierId
parameters.description: The supplier identifier exactly as printed on the invoice, for example SUP-1001.

404.description: No supplier exists with that ID.

get.summary: Get purchase order with lines and goods receipts
get.description: Returns a single purchase order including every line item, the quantity ordered, the agreed unit price, and the quantity actually received against each line. This is the authoritative source for a three-way match between invoice, purchase order and goods receipt. Returns 404 when the purchase order number does not exist, which must be treated as an exception rather than an error.

parameters.name: poNumber
parameters.description: The purchase order number exactly as printed on the invoice, for example PO-45001.

404.description: No purchase order exists with that number.

get.summary: List purchase orders for a supplier
get.description: Returns purchase orders filtered by supplier and optionally by status. Use this when an invoice does not quote a purchase order number and you need to find candidate orders for the supplier.

200.description: A list of matching purchase orders.

post.summary: Post an approved invoice for payment
post.description: Records an invoice as approved and schedules it for payment. Call this only after the invoice has passed the three-way match, or after a human approver has explicitly approved an exception. This operation changes financial data and must never be called speculatively.

409.description: This invoice was already posted. Treat as a duplicate, not as a failure.

status.description: Approval status. One of Approved, On Hold, Blocked. Only Approved suppliers may be paid.

paymentTerms.description: Agreed payment terms, for example NET30.

apContactEmail.description: Supplier accounts-receivable contact for payment queries.

supplierId.description: Supplier the order was placed with.

poStatus.description: Order status. One of Open, Partially Received, Closed, Cancelled. Invoices may only be matched against Open or Partially Received orders.

currency.description: Currency the order was raised in, ISO 4217. The invoice currency must match this exactly.

orderDate.description: Date the order was raised, yyyy-MM-dd.

buyerEmail.description: Contoso buyer who raised the order. Route sourcing questions here.

lines.description: Order lines with ordered and received quantities.

sku.description: Item code. Match invoice lines to order lines on this value.

qtyReceived.description: Total quantity actually received and booked in. Never pay for more than this quantity.

unitPrice.description: Agreed unit price on the order. Compare the invoiced unit price against this value.

lineAmount.description: Ordered quantity multiplied by unit price.

goodsReceipts.description: Individual goods receipt records against this line. An empty array means nothing has been received yet.

qtyReceived.description: Quantity booked in on this receipt.

supplierInvoiceNumber.description: Invoice number as printed by the supplier.

poNumber.description: Purchase order the invoice is matched to.

matchResult.description: Outcome that authorised this posting. One of AUTO_CLEAR or APPROVED_EXCEPTION.

approvedBy.description: Email of the human approver, required when matchResult is APPROVED_EXCEPTION.

scheduledPaymentDate.description: Date payment is scheduled for, yyyy-MM-dd.
